what: A live-first instrument: four synth tracks with their own loops, Capture (play freely, press once, it loops in time), undo, scenes and Morph, hold-to-play stutter and filter throws, and a Creative Engine that mutates, humanizes, fills or simplifies what you played.
author: Tom-Rfid

smk37.what: The same live instrument on the SMK-37 Elite and Pro: 37 keys, pressure pads for perform effects, mutes and scenes, faders and wheels you can assign, MIDI out to a drum machine.
